# bitbucket_project_user_permission (Resource)

Grants a user a permission level (read/write/admin) on a Bitbucket Cloud project, applying to every repository inside it.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "bitbucket_project_user_permission" "owner" {
  project_key = bitbucket_project.platform.key
  user        = "jcardenas"
  permission  = "admin"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `permission` (String) Permission level: "read", "write" or "admin".
- `project_key` (String) Key of the project to grant access to.
- `user` (String) UUID or Atlassian account ID of the user to grant access to.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Identifier, formatted as "workspace/project_key/user".

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import bitbucket_project_user_permission.owner PLAT/jcardenas
```
